name: Viking 5 Series 30” Stainless Steel 4-Burner Electric Rangetop with Brushed Brass Trim
shortDescription: The electric rangetop brings electric professional performance to the counter. QuickCook™ surface elements reach full power in about three seconds.

features.text: The electric rangetop brings electric professional performance to the counter. QuickCook™ surface elements reach full power in about three seconds. Surface elements offer a wide range of wattages and sizes, and a special bridge element creates a continuous surface between the front and rear elements.
Sculpted polished chrome bezels and stainless steel knobs bring new clarity and cohesion to the Viking 5 Series Range, refining its presence while honoring its iconic heritage.
Feature innovative ribbon technology that allows them to reach full power in just three seconds.
Located between the center front and center rear elements, excellent for griddling with an optional accessory.
Enhance the control panel's appearance and provide illumination for the knobs, adding a stylish touch to your cooking area.
Ensures fast and efficient surface cooking, regardless of the type of cookware used.
Wide Range of Surface Elements and Wattages
Offers a variety of element sizes and power levels for versatile cooking options
Two-year full – complete product; Ninety-day full – cosmetic parts such as glass, painted items, and decorative items; Five-year limited - electric element
